title: Leveraging LLMs for User Stories in AI Systems: UStAI Dataset
reasoning: The paper includes a core research question (RQ3) and specific benchmarking focused on evaluating how well LLMs capture and incorporate ethical principles (such as fairness, transparency, and non-maleficence) into generated user stories. This goes beyond a standard ethical considerations section, as it is a primary metric for the quality and utility of the dataset and models.
